globalProperty.description:
OPD Visit. The visit opened at registration when the request does not name one, and the fallback used by the revisit endpoint.
This must be set for arrival facts to work at all: referral, MLC and patient category are stored against the visit, so with no visit there is nowhere to put them. Registration refuses rather than dropping them silently.
Registration encounter type, carrying each arrival's referral and MLC answers as obs. One encounter per arrival (§9.7), not one per patient.

Patient Category. Comma-separated visit attribute type uuids whose value carries forward from a patient's most recent visit, used by the revisit screen's prefill.
Category carries because it stays true between arrivals — a BPL patient is still BPL next month — so the clerk accepts it with one keystroke rather than retyping it. Nothing else is listed: a payment method last time says nothing about today, and referral and MLC cannot appear here at all because they are obs rather than attributes, precisely so an MLC flag can never land on an arrival it was never true of.
This replaced hispindia.registration.patientCategoryAttributeTypeName. Visit attributes now reach the server keyed by their own type uuid, so it no longer has to be told which type the category lives on — the registration page and the stock dashboard visit form both name it, and the server writing whichever type it was sent is what keeps those two entry points on the same row (D16).
